title: Context alert keeps blinking after a compaction until Claude's next reply
seam: context-usage tracking: src-tauri/src/core/transcript_parser.rs, claude_event.rs, src/stores/useSessionStore.ts, src/types/claude-events.ts
story: My terminal hit the context warning and started blinking red. Claude then compacted the conversation and the figure dropped to about 5%, but Maestro kept blinking until Claude's next answer. Now the figure and the blinking follow the compaction at once.

checks.criterion: After a compaction, a terminal that was at or above the alert percent shows the new low percent, and its alert is off.
checks.steps: Start Maestro fresh. In Settings, set the context alert card to 50%. Launch a Claude terminal and work until its context reads at least 50% (frame, project tab and header icon blink red). Type /compact and wait for 'Conversation compacted'. Send no other message.
checks.expected: Right after the compaction the context figure drops to a few percent, and the red frame, project tab, zoom tab, parked chip and header icon all stop blinking without waiting for Claude's next reply.

checks.criterion: A normal context reading after the compaction still replaces the value.
checks.steps: Continue from the check above. Send one message such as 'say hi' and wait for the reply.
checks.expected: The context figure updates to the new reading, slightly above the post-compaction figure, and the alert stays off.

checks.criterion: Replaying a transcript that ends on a compaction lands on the post-compaction percent.
checks.steps: Compact a terminal as in the first check and send no message after it. Close and reopen Maestro, or resume that conversation from History.
checks.expected: The terminal shows the post-compaction percent (or none), never the old high figure, and no red alert.
